scope: text-to-audio-token graph; EnCodec waveform synthesis outside scope
aggregation: All tensor uses for the fixed 8-position graph are accumulated exactly into flattened per-node neuron-index bins. Dense matrix uses repeat once per relevant token position; embedding lookups use the stated selected IDs; output heads cover every class at every position. Attention structural dependencies enumerate all valid token pairs (full encoder, causal decoder, full cross-attention). Bundles aggregate routes; no edge sampling. LayerNorm parameters are fused into transformer blocks and listed separately. QKV projections, attention scores, contexts, output projections, residual streams, and FFN activations each have explicit activation nodes.
fixed_position_embedding_tensor: decoder.model.decoder.embed_positions.weights (sinusoidal, non-trainable; represented by structural position-ID routes)
omissions: EnCodec encoder and decoder weights; graph terminates at the four codebook logits.
text_token_ids_semantics: Eight illustrative IDs; token text is not decoded or claimed. ID 0 is explicitly unmasked by the all-ones attention mask for this fixed shape graph.
